question: How many new greenfield expressways are targeted for construction in India by the financial year 2024-25?
solution:
The correct answer is __**22**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The government of India has set a target to construct **22 greenfield expressways** by the financial year 2024-25 under the Bharatmala Pariyojana.
 
• These expressways are being developed to improve **connectivity between major economic centers** and reduce travel time significantly across states.
 
• The initiative includes expressways like the **Delhi-Mumbai Expressway**, Ahmedabad-Dholera Expressway, and Bengaluru-Chennai Expressway.
 
• The construction of these expressways aims to enhance **logistics efficiency**, boost trade, and create employment opportunities.
 
• Greenfield expressways are designed to be **environmentally sustainable**, leveraging advanced engineering and planning techniques.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatmala Pariyojana**

 
 
• It is a centrally-sponsored and funded road and highway project launched in 2017.
 
• The primary objective is to develop seamless freight corridors and improve road infrastructure across India.
 
• Greenfield expressways under this initiative are planned for high-speed connectivity and reduced congestion.
 
 
 
• **Greenfield Project**
 
 
• A greenfield project refers to a new infrastructure initiative built from scratch on undeveloped land.
 
• Such projects aim to utilize advanced planning methods to ensure optimal efficiency and sustainability.
 
 
 
• **Key Expressways Under Construction**
 
 
• **Delhi-Mumbai Expressway:** A 1,386 km-long expressway connecting Delhi and Mumbai with reduced travel time to approximately 12 hours.
 
• **Bengaluru-Chennai Expressway:** A 262 km-long expressway aimed at reducing travel time between the two cities.
 
• **Ahmedabad-Dholera Expressway:** A vital project to boost connectivity between Ahmedabad and the Dholera Special Investment Region.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Benefits of Greenfield Expressways**
 
 
• Designed to minimize carbon emissions by enabling fuel-efficient travel.
 
• Incorporates measures to protect surrounding ecosystems and reduce environmental impact.
